name: x4_nemotron_modes

selection_on_dev.rule:
Pre-declared dev rule: maximise failure-type accuracy on failures (unparsed = wrong) subject to
    balanced success accuracy (unparsed = wrong) >= frozen v2 dev value - 0.05; keep the best 2.

notes: Variant choice used the dev split only (36 episodes, seeds 300000+).
Frozen v2 baseline = eval_nebius_v2.jsonl rows; episodes recorded after it ran were scored with the same frozen settings (V2_frozen) in this exploration's scratch file.
Harmonized failure type = failure_annotator applied after the first 10 sim steps (square nut spawns about 6 cm above the table and settles), a sim-state relabel that never uses model outputs.
